prompts.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D fighting-game animation atlas. INPUT 1 is Xiao character identity, INPUT 2 shows mandatory sparse 4x4 layout and painting style. Create Xiao matching INPUT 1 precisely, same teal-black hair, golden eyes, forehead purple diamond, white sleeveless top, right arm green tattoo, purple trousers, teal sashes, waist yaksha mask and jade-bladed long spear.
EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS AND FOUR ROWS: sixteen distinct poses in row-major order. Square canvas. Each invisible equal cell contains one COMPLETE tiny Xiao full-body sprite with his entire polearm. Match sparse second reference: about 80% of canvas is transparent empty space. Each sprite's standing BODY height only 42% of its cell height; complete silhouette INCLUDING ENTIRE SPEAR must fit within central 65% of cell width and 65% of cell height. Wide fully transparent gutters surround EACH individual sprite. Fixed same body size, fixed side-on three-quarter camera, normally facing RIGHT. Character's anatomy and clothes consistent in all sixteen poses. No ground, no background, no panels, no grid, no text, no labels, no shadows, no glow clouds. No crossing cell boundaries or clipped tips. True RGBA transparency.
Row 1 four movement keyframes: idle ready stance holding polearm diagonally; run contact right foot forward with spear trailing; run passing left foot forward; upward jump, both knees visibly off ground, spear diagonally behind.
Row 2 four normal spear attack keyframes: windup draw spear back by hip; deep lunge thrust pointed spear horizontally RIGHT; followthrough twisting shoulders retract spear; recovery guard.
Row 3 four heavy attack keyframes: windup raise spear overhead with two hands; strong forward sweeping spear slash; followthrough lowered wide stance spear finishing diagonal sweep; recovery straighten torso.
Row 4 is Xiao's special aerial plunging attack, MUST differ dramatically from horizontal attack. Cell 13: in mid-air, masked Xiao tucks one knee and grips spear ready to aim vertically downward. Cell 14: HIGH SPEED VERTICAL DOWNWARD PLUNGE, Xiao body upright slightly tilted toward screen, both hands grip spear shaft in front of him, jade spear TIP POINTS STRAIGHT DOWN below his feet, torso above spear tip, legs trailing/folded upward, NOT a horizontal lunge. Cell 15: LANDING low crouch with spear stabbed straight VERTICALLY into ground under him, hands above tip, knees folded, wearing glowing teal yaksha mask. Cell 16: recover standing with spear pulled out into guard, mask back at hip.
Refined Japanese fantasy anime hand-painted keyframes, crisp silhouettes and clean subtle details readable at small game size. Every pose must actually change limbs and torso. Spear should be shorter in atlas to safely fit gutters, but recognizable single jade polearm. Tiny subtle teal light on blade, NO effects beyond body silhouette, effects will be added by game. Mask is dark horned yaksha mask covering face only in row4 first three frames. Preserve same anatomical body size across all sixteen frames; do not enlarge crouches. Huge clear transparent bands at every row and column boundary. Return a SQUARE 4x4 atlas.
